title: Senior Analytics Engineer, Consumer OR Merchant
description:
**About Wolt**
 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
   

  

 Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
   

  

 Analytics at Wolt is a business-critical area that covers three different teams: data science, regional business operations, and analytics engineering. The complexity of online delivery, differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, and vast amounts of data make our work truly interesting!
   

  

 Now we are looking for two experienced
 **Senior Analytics Engineers** 
 to join our
 **Analytics Engineering** 
 teams (
 **Consumer or Merchant domain** 
 ). You can work in
 **Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki** 
 .
   

  

**About The Role**
 The role is focused on the business needs - you’ll be working within a cross-functional team, making sure your teammates get the insights needed for their operations. The role requires interpreting the needs and requests of our internal stakeholders from business and product, and transforming them into actionable data. Data Scientists working in the domain will be your closest partners in your day-to-day work, as your solutions will enable them to create relevant experiments, A/B tests, and analyses.
   

  

**Your daily work will include**
* Developing reporting and metrics quality as a whole, from understanding the needs of the business to providing easily understandable and actionable data.
* Working on our centrally maintained data integrations and data pipelines powering our Data Warehouse, our data models, and dashboards. You'll get to utilize our modern tech stack as part of your work (Snowflake, SQL, Looker, Wolt Inhouse ETL, Airflow, Dagster, Github).
* Design and implement complex data pipelines with dependency control, orchestration, and auto-materialisation logic.
* Develop a self-service data modelling strategy and partner with Analytics and other stakeholders for implementation.
* Increase data literacy across the domain and expertise through hands-on training and documentation.
* Lead, mentor, and guide more junior team members.


 Our humble expectations
   

  

* 5+ years of experience working as an Analytics Engineer or BI Developer.
* Strong hands-on experience with data integrations, data pipelines, data models, metric development, and dashboards.
* Tech skills: Snowflake, SQL, Airflow, DBT, Looker, or other visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, etc.
* Advanced SQL skills and ability to write optimized queries for large data sets.
* Strong business acumen and product-oriented thinking with significant experience in the design and implementation of analytics and reporting data models.


 What we offer
   

  

* The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.
* You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki. You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote within the location above. 💙
* You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don’t learn, we won’t stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda’s greatest achievement.


 Next steps
   

  

 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!
   

  

 For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Product+ Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via zhanna.filintseva@wolt.com
   

  

 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
   

  

 We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Content Specialist
description:
Are you interested in creating content that performs - curious about how AI is reshaping the way people search and discover brands, and just as curious about how AI can sharpen the way you work? Do you see yourself working with great writing, SEO, and the fast-moving world of AI search and Digital PR?
 



 We are looking for a new Content Specialist for our team in Stockholm - maybe you are the one we are looking for?
 



  





**About us** 




 Bonzer is a specialized SEO (Search Engine Optimization) agency helping businesses grow their online presence across Google and AI search platforms like ChatGPT and Copilot. We're experts in tailoring organic growth strategies that combine strong SEO fundamentals with the latest developments in search and AI technology - always aligned with each client's unique goals and ambitions.
 



  





**The role** 




 As our new Content Specialist, you will be part of a team where your primary responsibility is to produce different types of high-quality content for Bonzer's clients - content built to rank at the top of Google and to be visible in AI search platforms and language models.
 



 Your work will typically include content types such as blog posts, product and category texts, press releases, and Digital PR content, as well as graphic and interactive formats. Every piece you create should combine strong craftsmanship with a clear strategic purpose: helping our clients grow through organic visibility.
 



 Search is changing rapidly. More and more people find answers, products, and brands through AI models - and being visible in those answers is becoming just as important as ranking on Google.
 



  





 As a Content Specialist at Bonzer, you will work hands-on with this shift every day: creating content that AI models pick up, cite, and trust, and supporting Digital PR efforts that build the authority and mentions that drive AI visibility. The same curiosity that makes you want to understand this shift is exactly what we're looking for when it comes to your own way of working too - we want someone who's naturally drawn to exploring how new AI tools can make their day-to-day sharper. Not because someone tells you to, but because it's genuinely fun for you to figure out what's suddenly possible.
 



 In this role, we do not expect you to know everything from day one, but we do expect you to deliver strong content – and to take ownership of your tasks, quality, and deadlines.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 We imagine that you are early in your career, but do have some experience to bring to the table - preferably with a background in content creation, journalism, communication, marketing, or similar areas.
 



 Above all, you are a genuinely strong writer. You know how to create texts that are engaging, well-structured, and tailored to different audiences and formats - and you take pride in delivering quality every time.
 



 Experience with SEO is not a requirement, but we want to see a genuine interest in AI search, visibility in AI models, and Digital PR. Just as important: we want someone who's curious about AI as a tool, not just as a topic - someone who gets a kick out of testing new AI tools and figuring out how they can make their own work sharper, simply because it's fun to see what's suddenly possible.
 



  





**In addition, we imagine that you:** 



* Are adaptable and thrive in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same
* Have a strong ability and willingness to learn
* Have a basic knowledge of digital marketing
* Are organized, structured, and good at keeping an overview of multiple tasks and deadlines
* Take responsibility for your own performance and contribute to your team's shared goals



  





 We are proud of our employees and the culture we create together. That is why we are looking for new colleagues who thrive in a collaborative environment, value community, and share the same values as us, so that together we can strengthen each other and the company.
 



 We value your character, craftsmanship, and teamwork above all - and we'll equip you with the SEO and AI search knowledge to build a strong career with us. In addition, you must be a resident of Sweden and fully fluent in Swedish, as the role is based at our Stockholm office. Fluency in English is also required, as it is our primary working language across markets.
 



  





**Benefits of the job** 



* Work hands-on with AI search, AI visibility, and Digital PR - some of the most exciting and fast-growing areas in marketing
* Gain valuable insight and experience in SEO and the latest developments in AI-driven search
* Take on responsibility and independent tasks that contribute to your professional and personal development
* Work closely with experienced and specialized professionals in the industry
* Rapid development and career opportunities
* Opportunity for mentorship and skills development
* Become part of an international company in the Scandinavian markets (Denmark & Norway)
* Become a part of a strong team culture with regular events and activities that bring colleagues together
* Be part of Bonzer - a growing team of 50 passionate specialists working together to create impact



  





**Recruitment process** 




 If you are interested in the role of Content Specialist at Bonzer, please upload your CV, a short cover letter, and 1-2 writing samples you are proud of.
 



 We will get back to you directly if we see a potential match and invite you to a short introductory interview.
 



  





 The recruitment process consists of the following steps:
 


1. First interview
2. Second interview with case
3. Final interview



  





 We look forward to receiving your application!
 



 Best regards, Team Bonzer

title: Category Development Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 At Kraft Heinz, we believe that success comes from passion, courage, and team spirit. As a global company with strong values and a clear vision, we are looking for people who want to take responsibility and make a difference—every day!
   

  

 We have an excellent opportunity with a great potential of impact for a Category Development Manager as part of our Nordics organisation either right in the heart of Stockholm in Nordics HQ office or close to Copenhagen in our DK entity. In this cross-boarder role you would be together with the Category Development team responsible for the strategic and commercial performance to ensure growth, profitability and customer value. There will also be a strong interface with our EPDM team based in the Netherlands and the UK. Get ready for an exciting journey driving one of the most iconic brands.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute category strategies to drive growth, profitability, and market share within the Nordics market (from Denmark to Iceland) together with your team
* Analyse market trends, consumer insights, and category performance to identify opportunities in close cooperation with your counterpart in Marketing
* Manage the product portfolio, including assortment, pricing, promotions, and lifecycle planning.
* Collaborate with Sales, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams to deliver category objectives locally and within the EU-Zone
* Lead new product launches and category development initiatives
* Monitor category KPIs and provide data-driven recommendations to optimize performance to align with overall business strategy and commercial objectives
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and external partners where applicable


**Your Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in Category Management, Trade Marketing or Sales, preferably within FMCG and with first personnel experience
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting market and sales data
* Proven experience in category planning, portfolio management, and commercial decision-making
* Excellent project management and organizational skills combined with strong communication and stakeholder management abilities
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with syndicated market data (e.g., Nielsen, Circana/IRI) is an advantage
* Fluent in English is a must-have; additional language skills are an advantage.


**Professional attributes**
* Can do mentality: You work proactive, solution-oriented and get things done.
* Ability to Simplify: Find simple solutions to complex challenges.
* High pressure: A fast paced and dynamic environment is what keeps you energized.
* Team player: You are always working towards the same common goal together with your teammates.
* Analytical: We are a very data-driven company, so the ability to translate complex data into simple solutions while taking an analytical approach is key.


**What We Offer**
* A competitive salary and excellent bonus structure (above market average)
* Flexible working hours in a hybrid working model
* An international, matrix-organized working environment with great opportunities to develop both personally and professionally
* Attractive social and employee benefits (e.g., company pension scheme, corporate benefits, and much more)


 Location(s)
   

  

 Stockholm
   

  

**Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Underrepresented Ethnic Minority Groups/Women/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity and other protected classes** 
**.**

title: BUSINESS OPERATIONS DIRECTOR / COO
description:
AVOLT is a Stockholm-based design studio with a team of around 10 people, creating products that combine Scandinavian design with everyday functionality. We sell internationally through our own e-commerce, Amazon, retailers, agents and distributors, while also working with architects, interior designers and hospitality partners across Europe, the US and beyond.
 



  





 We are now looking for a Business Operations Director / COO to join our team in Stockholm and take a key role in the next stage of AVOLT.
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




 This is a broad and hands-on role at the center of the business, working closely with our CEO and other senior members of the team.
 



  





 You will be responsible for making sure the business behind AVOLT works and continues to scale as we grow internationally.
 



  





 The role covers areas such as:
 


* Business operations and company-wide projects
* Leading and developing our sales operations and back-office function
* B2B, distributor and agent operations
* Supply chain, purchasing and inventory
* 3PL, freight and international logistics
* Budgeting, forecasting and business follow-up
* Systems, data and automation
* New markets and international expansion
* Contracts, compliance and external partners
* Supporting the CEO and senior team in strategic and operational decisions



  





 You will work closely across the company, particularly with sales, product development and our Sales & Operations Coordinator, as well as with our international distributors, agents and external partners.
 



  





 Our Sales & Operations Coordinator manages much of the day-to-day operational flow across B2B and e-commerce, including order handling, invoicing, customer administration and coordination with our 3PL partners.
 



  





 Your role is to own and develop the processes and systems behind this, solve more complex operational issues, and ensure the function can scale as AVOLT grows.
 



  





**FINANCE & BUSINESS** 




 You should be comfortable with numbers and understand how P&L, margins, inventory and forecasting connect to the wider business.
 



  





 AVOLT operates through AVOLT AB in Sweden and its wholly owned US subsidiary, AVOLT Inc. The role involves understanding and coordinating the financial and operational flows across both entities, together with our external accounting and specialist partners.
 



  





 Together with the CEO and senior team, you will work with budgeting, forecasting and business follow-up, using data to support decisions across the company.
 



  





 This is not an accounting role. We work with external accounting firms and other specialists where it makes sense. What matters is that you understand the numbers, make sure we have control and can turn insights into action.
 



  





**DIGITAL & AI** 




 AVOLT is already a highly digital organization. Across the team, we use AI, automation and tools such as Claude Code, Lovable and ChatGPT to build our own solutions and improve how we work.
 



  





 You won't be alone in this – it is already part of how we operate.
 



  





 We're looking for someone who enjoys working this way and wants to take it further. You don't need to be a developer, but you should be technically curious and interested in building, testing and improving things yourself.
 



  





**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




 We are looking for a curious, driven and humble person who wants to take responsibility and be part of building the next stage of AVOLT.
 



  





 Ideally, you have spent a few years in a broad business or operations role at a growing international consumer, e-commerce or product company. You understand how e-commerce, wholesale, inventory, cash, margins, logistics and international expansion fit together.
 



  





 You enjoy learning new things, solving problems and making things happen. You don't need to know everything from day one, but you should have relevant experience to build from and be motivated to keep learning and developing.
 



  





 You thrive in an environment where the pace can be high, decisions sometimes need to be made quickly and everyone contributes to moving things forward. You are hands-on and comfortable switching between the big picture and the details – from strategic questions to rolling up your sleeves and getting things done.
 



  





 Execution is an important part of our culture. We value people who take initiative, take ownership and turn ideas and decisions into action.
 



  





 We think you are:
 


* Business-minded and commercially driven
* Strong with numbers and analysis
* Experienced in business operations
* Comfortable with supply chain, inventory and logistics
* Comfortable with finance without necessarily being a finance specialist
* Curious about systems, data, AI and automation
* Hands-on, pragmatic and unpretentious
* Proactive and comfortable taking initiative
* Someone who takes a high level of ownership and follows things through



  





 An interest in interiors, design, craftsmanship or the creative process is a plus. Perhaps you are fascinated by materials, details and quality, or simply enjoy understanding how an idea becomes a finished product.
 



  





 You will work closely with the CEO and other senior members of the team. This means a high level of trust, short decision-making processes and a genuine opportunity to influence the company.
 



  





 Things are not always predictable – we test, adapt, make changes and learn along the way. We believe you should be comfortable with both successes and challenges and see both as a natural part of building a company.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who wants to be genuinely involved – not simply fill a role, but contribute to developing the business and how we work.
 



  





 The role will involve international travel, including trips to Asia and the US, so you should be comfortable travelling when the business requires it.
 



  





**ABOUT AVOLT** 




 We're a small team with an international business and ambitious plans for the coming years.
 



  





 We want to stay lean as we grow and use great people, technology, AI, automation and strong external partners rather than building large departments.
 



  





 The goal of this role is to make sure the business behind AVOLT works and scales, allowing us to continue growing internationally without adding unnecessary complexity or headcount.
 



  





 For the right person, this is an opportunity to take significant responsibility, have a real influence on how AVOLT develops over the coming years and be part of our ambition to build a lasting Swedish design brand.

title: Inköpare
description:
Sökes till Stockholm
   

  

 Vi söker nu en inköpare till Peab Drift och Underhåll i Stockholm. Ta chansen att bli en del av vårt team och bidra till vårt fortsatta framgångsrika arbete!
   

  

 Peab drift och underhåll är en region inom Peab Anläggning och kärnverksamheten består av löpande drift och underhåll av vägar, gator och torg, park och gatuskötsel samt yttre fastighetsskötsel, blomsterprogram, trädgårdsanläggningar, arboristtjänster, samt upprustning av parker och lekplatser. Vi ser till att landets invånare och besökare kan trivas och vistas säkert i vår utemiljö och trafik. Vi har stor erfarenhet av entreprenader som ställer höga krav på service, kvalitet, miljö och tillgänglighet.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Som inköpare kommer du att ansvara för att genomföra inköp av material och tjänster. Du
   

  

 kommer att hantera förfrågningar, förhandla avtal och säkerställa att inköpen sker enligt
   

  

 budget och tidsplan. I rollen samarbetar du tätt med både interna kollegor och externa leverantörer.
   

  

**I Rollen Ingår Bland Annat Att**
* Utveckla och implementera inköpsstrategier i linje med projektets mål och tidsramar.
* Säkerställa leverans av material och tjänster enligt överenskomna specifikationer och tidsplaner.
* Stötta våra Platschefer med inköp.
* Hantera och utvärdera leverantörer.
* Samarbeta med produktionsledningen för att identifiera inköpsbehov.
* Hantera risker relaterade till inköp och föreslå alternativa lösningar vid behov.
* Arbeta i enlighet med Peabs riktlinjer och etiska standarder.


**Om dig**
 Vi söker dig som är affärsmässig, strukturerad och kommunikativ där du är skicklig på att bygga och vårda relationer. Du trivs i en roll där du både arbetar självständigt och i team. Med din nyfikenhet och öppna inställning bidrar du till en positiv och utvecklande arbetsmiljö.
   

  

**För Att Lyckas i Rollen Har Du**
* En relevant högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet inom produktion, inköp eller logistik
* Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med inköp, gärna inom bygg- och anläggningsbranschen
* Du har förståelse för kontrakt och juridiska dokument
* Goda kunskaper i Officepaketet, medan erfarenhet av arbete med inköpssystem är meriterande
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift
* B-körkort


**Praktisk Information**
**Start:** 
 Enligt överenskommelse
   

  

**Omfattning:** 
 Tillsvidare, med sex månaders provanställning
   

  

**Placering:** 
 Stockholm
   

  

 Urval till tjänsten sker löpande så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan.
   

  

 Om du har frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Avdelningschef Daniel Patzelt, daniel.patzelt@peab.se
   

  

 Har du frågor om rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterare Frida Thorén, frida.thoren@peab.se
   

  

 Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via mail.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
   

  

 Vi kan komma att genomföra bakgrundskontroller på våra slutkandidater som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess.
   

  

 I denna rekrytering har vi gjort ett aktivt val av annonsering och rekryteringsstöd och avböjer oss vänligt men bestämt kontakt från rekryterings- eller annonseringsbolag.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder**
 I Peabkoncernen blir du delaktig i det spännande arbetet att bygga framtidens hållbara samhälle. Vi engagerar oss i sociala frågor och i frågor som rör miljön för de människor som nu och i framtiden påverkas av det vi bygger och anlägger. Vi vill tillvarata all kompetens på arbetsmarknaden och eftersträvar mångfald.
   

  

 Det är viktigt för oss att du delar våra kärnvärden jordnära, utvecklande, personliga och pålitliga eftersom de är grundläggande för det vi gör. Hos oss finns stora möjligheter till personlig utveckling. Vill du bygga ett hållbart samhälle med oss?
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan!
   

  

 Sök tjänsten
   

  

 Peab är Nordens samhällsbyggare med 13 000 medarbetare och en omsättning på 60 miljarder kronor. Med lokal närvaro och fokus på egna resurser utvecklar, anlägger och bygger vi vardagen där livet levs. Huvudkontoret finns i Förslöv på Bjärehalvön i Skåne. Aktien är noterad vid Nasdaq Stockholm.

title: AI Technical Product Manager
description:
Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses - including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others - rely on Sinch's Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.
 



 Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.
 



 At Sinch we "Dream Big", "Win Together", "Keep it simple", and "Make it Happen". These values are our foundation!
 



**DESCRIPTION** 




 Sinch is on a multi-year journey to responsibly scale AI across Enterprise IT (EIT). We're looking for a Specialist AI Technical Product Manager to take ownership of core AI capabilities as part of the EIT domain to ensure AI is safe, effective, and enterprise-ready.
 



 You'll partner closely with our central AI Function (responsible for end-user experience, including agent configuration and design) and act as the bridge to Infrastructure, End-User Support, Security, and other IT teams. You'll define, deliver, and continuously improve the technical products, integrations, and operating model that enable AI at scale.
 



 This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden (Hybrid) and reports to the VP, Business Operations EIT.
 



**What You'll Do** 



* Own the AI Product Strategy: Define and manage the roadmap for enterprise AI capabilities, including connectors, LLM services, governance tools, and guardrails.
* Deliver Secure Integrations: Design and implement AI connectors for platforms like Microsoft 365, Slack, Jira, SAP, and data warehouses, ensuring performance and resilience.
* Build Knowledge Foundations: Set standards for data ingestion, classification, enrichment, and retention to power AI systems while protecting sensitive information.
* Drive AI Quality & Safety: Define success metrics, run A/B tests, and establish monitoring for drift, hallucinations, and compliance.
* Ensure Security & Compliance: Collaborate with Security, Legal, and Privacy teams to meet ISO 27001, SOC 2, and GDPR requirements; create incident response playbooks.
* Enable Adoption: Develop support playbooks, training programs, and clear roles across IT and business units to scale AI responsibly.



**REQUIREMENTS** 



* **Education** 
 : Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred).
* **Experience** 
 : 3+ years in Product Management or Technical Program roles delivering AI/ML or data-driven products in enterprise environments.
* **Technical Expertise** 
 :
	+ Hands-on with LLMs and platforms like OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock (Google Agentspace is a plus).
	+ Familiarity with RAG architectures, embeddings, prompt management, and evaluation frameworks.
	+ Experience building secure APIs/connectors (REST/GraphQL) and working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
	+ Knowledge of enterprise IT systems (Microsoft 365, Jira, Slack) and identity/access management (Azure AD, Okta).
* **Security & Compliance** 
 : Strong grounding in data privacy, DLP, PII handling, and audit requirements.
* **Ways of Working** 
 : Comfortable with Agile/Scrum; able to write clear PRDs and architecture diagrams.
* **Soft Skills** 
 : Excellent communication and stakeholder management; proven ability to influence and lead change.
* **Nice to Have** 
 : ITIL v4 and cloud certifications.



 Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in
 **English** 
 .
 



 Must currently reside in and be eligible for employment in Stockholm, Sweden.
 



 Relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this role
 



**OUR HIRING PROCESS** 




 We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.
 



 We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!
 



**Salary** 
 :
 



 The monthly base salary for this position is between 65 000 SEK to 85 000 SEK. Factors which may affect pay within this range may include skills, education, experience, and other qualifications.

title: Front of House till The Nooq
description:
*Var med och bidra till en gästupplevelse som känns på riktigt! Som Front of House på The Nooq blir du en del av ett levande och socialt sammanhang där personligt bemötande och äkta möten står i centrum. Här får du en dynamisk och meningsfull roll där varje dag är unik och där din personlighet, ditt engagemang och dina idéer gör verklig skillnad för upplevelsen.*
**Om tjänsten**
 Den här tjänsten är en direktrekrytering vilket innebär att rekryteringsprocessen sker genom Bravura och du anställs direkt hos The Nooq.
   

  

**Om företaget**
 The Nooq är mer än ett hotell. Det är ett levande community och en social mötesplats där nyfikna människor möts i en öppen och välkomnande miljö. Här är vistelsen mer än bara in- och utcheckning, den handlar om relationer, upplevelser och en genuin känsla av att höra hemma. Gäster stannar ofta längre, lär känna varandra och bygger relationer med teamet på plats. Det gör din roll mer personlig, dynamisk och meningsfull än i ett traditionellt hotell.
   

  

 The Nooq är en del av COLIVE och kombinerar erfarenheten från coliving och coworkning med ett modernt hotellkoncept. Här skapas mer än bara en plats att bo på – här byggs ett community där människor kan bo, arbeta, mötas och känna sig hemma.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
 Som Front of House är du en viktig kontaktpunkt för gästerna och en central del av den dagliga driften på anläggningarna i Alvik och Bromma. Du välkomnar och hjälper gäster genom hela vistelsen, hanterar bokningar och betalningar och säkerställer att reception och gemensamma ytor håller en hög standard. Det här är en hands-on-roll där man arbetar tillsammans över avdelningsgränserna. Du förväntas vara flexibel och hjälpa till där verksamheten och dina kollegor behöver stöd. Arbetstiderna varierar och omfattar dag-, kvälls- och helgarbete.
   

  

 Här arbetar som ett team med ett gemensamt mål – att skapa den bästa möjliga gästupplevelsen.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Be visionary**
 Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.
   

  

 We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Technical Support Engineer - Tier 2**
 Flir Instruments
   

  

* Technical Support Organization


 Full-Time
   

  

* Field & In-House
* Up to 50% Travel (Domestic & International)


**About The Role**
 At Flir, we build technologies that help people see what matters most. Our Instruments organization serves a wide range of industrial customers — from utilities and manufacturers to data centers and fulfillment operations — who rely on our thermal cameras and test equipment to keep their operations safe, efficient, and running.
   

  

 As a Tier 2 Technical Support Engineer, you will be at the intersection of cutting-edge hardware and enterprise software, delivering advanced support to our customers and empowering our Tier 1 support team. This is a dynamic, highly visible role that combines deep technical expertise with meaningful field engagement — no two days look exactly the same. You will own complex cases from initial escalation through complete resolution, travel to customer sites to implement and train on our asset management and inspection software solutions, and serve as a trusted technical advisor to some of our most valued customers.
   

  

 Beyond direct customer engagement, this role sits at a unique crossroads within the organization. You will work closely with Product Management, Sales, and R&D teams — bringing real-world field insights back into the business, informing product development, and partnering with sales to ensure customers are set up for success from day one. Your voice will carry weight across the organization.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an experienced technical support professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, genuinely enjoys solving challenging problems, and finds satisfaction in building strong relationships with both customers and colleagues.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Customer & Field Support
   

  

* Travel to customer sites (up to 50% of the time, domestic and international) to provide hands-on technical support, software implementation, and solution deployment.
* Lead the setup and implementation of Flir’s asset management, inspection, and maintenance software solutions for industrial enterprise customers.
* Train customers to effectively use Flir software in concert with our hardware products, ensuring they achieve full value from their investment.
* Provide ongoing remote and on-site application support, troubleshooting hardware and software issues with urgency and thoroughness.
* Deliver a consistently positive customer experience, even in demanding or time-sensitive situations.


 Tier 1 Team Enablement
   

  

* Serve as the primary technical escalation point for Tier 1 support agents, guiding them through complex troubleshooting scenarios.
* Mentor and coach frontline representatives, building their product knowledge and problem-solving capabilities.
* Develop and maintain internal knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation to elevate team performance and consistency.


 Case Ownership & Resolution
   

  

* Own escalated support cases end-to-end, taking full accountability for timely and effective resolution.
* Manage multiple open cases simultaneously with strong organizational discipline and transparent communication to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Document findings and resolutions accurately to support institutional knowledge and continuous improvement.


 Cross-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Partner with product engineering teams to report and track identified product issues, providing detailed observations from the field.
* Collaborate closely with sales, product management, and service colleagues to ensure a cohesive and positive customer journey.
* Contribute insights from customer interactions to inform product improvements and support strategy.


 What You’ll Bring
   

  

 We’re looking for a seasoned professional who combines technical depth with strong interpersonal skills and a customer-first mindset.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; equivalent professional experience in lieu of degree will be considered.
* 5 or more years of experience in a technical support or field support engineering role, preferably within an industrial or instrumentation-focused environment.
* Demonstrated experience supporting hardware products and enterprise software solutions in customer-facing settings.
* Proven ability to independently troubleshoot complex hardware and software issues, with excellent diagnostic reasoning and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with software implementation, configuration, and end-user training in industrial or enterprise environments.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Word, Excel).
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% of the time, with domestic and international trips typically lasting 2 to 5 days.
* Self-directed and organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities autonomously while keeping internal teams and customers well-informed.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with thermal imaging cameras, test and measurement instruments, or related industrial hardware.
* Familiarity with asset management, inspection, or maintenance software used in industrial enterprise settings.
* Fluency in additional languages beyond English is a plus.
* Background in industries such as utilities, manufacturing, data centers, or fulfillment/operations.


**Who We Are — Our Team & Culture**
 Our global Technical Support team is made up of highly qualified, passionate individuals who are deeply committed to customer success. We’re a collaborative group that takes quality seriously and holds ourselves to a high standard — but we also genuinely enjoy the work and each other. When a colleague is wrestling with a tough case, we lean in. When a customer succeeds, we celebrate it together.
   

  

 We believe the best support comes from people who are curious, engaged, and care about doing things right. You’ll join a team that values your expertise, invests in your development, and trusts you to bring your best every day. High performance here doesn’t mean pressure for pressure’s sake — it means being surrounded by people who push each other to grow and consistently deliver for the customers who depend on us.
   

  

 If you’re energized by the idea of solving diverse, real-world technical challenges for customers across some of the most critical industries in the world — and you want to do it alongside a team that has your back — we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 This position requires access to export-controlled information or items (i.e. regulated technology or technical data per ITAR/EAR US regulations). Applicants must be eligible to apply for and obtain the appropriate export control license from the U.S. Departments of State or Commerce.
   

  

 Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

title: Kommunikatör till FoUUI-staben på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset
description:
Är du en nyfiken kommunikatör som vill bidra till utvecklingen av morgondagens sjukvård?
   

  

 Stab Forskning, Utbildning, Utveckling och Innovation (FoUUI) söker en erfaren och driven kommunikatör som vill bidra till att synliggöra och stärka Karolinska Universitetssjukhusets uppdrag som universitetssjukhus.
   

  

**Du erbjuds**
* varierande arbete i en kunskapsintensiv miljö där du arbetar nära engagerade kollegor både inom och utanför den egna staben
* ett meningsfullt uppdrag där du bidrar till att synliggöra sjukhusets forskning, utbildning, utveckling och innovation och dess betydelse för framtidens hälso- och sjukvård
* en utvecklande roll med stort eget ansvar och många kontaktytor inom sjukhuset, Region Stockholm och Karolinska Institutet


 Självklart får du också ta del av våra generella förmåner som Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset erbjuder dig.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 I rollen som kommunikatör på FoUUI-staben arbetar du brett med strategiskt och operativt kommunikationsstöd till stabens olika verksamheter och uppdrag. Du stödjer chefer, projekt och verksamheter i att planera, formulera och genomföra kommunikationsinsatser och bidrar till att komplex information blir tydlig, relevant och tillgänglig för olika målgrupper.
   

  

 Rollen innebär både självständigt arbete och nära samarbete med kollegor inom FoUUI-staben och sjukhusets centrala kommunikationsfunktion. Du kommer även att ha externa kontaktytor, framför allt inom Region Stockholm och med Karolinska Institutet. Du skriver även reportage och nyheter om aktuella framsteg inom sjukhusets forsknings- och utbildningsverksamhet. Du ansvarar också för stabens externa och interna webbsidor i rollen som webbsamordnare.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifterna Omfattar Bland Annat Att**
* formulera budskap och producera innehåll för olika målgrupper och kanaler
* skriva nyheter, reportage, webbtexter och nyhetsbrev
* synliggöra aktuella initiativ och framsteg inom sjukhusets forskning, utbildning, utveckling och innovation
* planera och genomföra kommunikationsinsatser samt ta fram kommunikations- och aktivitetsplaner
* ansvara för samordning, struktur och utveckling av FoUUI-stabens interna och externa webbsidor samt stödja lokala webbredaktörer
* ta fram grafiskt material och enklare filmproduktioner samt vara beställare vid större produktioner
* bidra med kommunikationsstöd i projekt, förändringsarbete och olika typer av evenemang


 Rollen kan även innebära kommunikationsstöd i sjukhusövergripande projekt och initiativ.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som**
* är nyfiken, utvecklingsorienterad och har lätt för att sätta dig in i nya och komplexa frågor
* kan snabbt identifiera vad som är viktigt, anpassa kommunikationen efter målgrupp och sammanhang och formulera tydliga och väl avvägda budskap
* har en förmåga att se till helheten och samtidigt har en känsla för detaljerna
* trivs i en miljö där förutsättningarna ibland förändras snabbt och där du behöver kunna prioritera mellan olika uppdrag
* arbetar självständigt och strukturerat, tar ansvar för att driva ditt arbete framåt och har samtidigt lätt för att samarbeta med andra.


 För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha gott omdöme och hög integritet. Du är trygg i din profession och bekväm med att både ge råd i kommunikationsfrågor och själv genomföra det operativa arbetet. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
**Krav**
* Högskoleutbildning inom kommunikation eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant
* Minst tre års relevant erfarenhet av kvalificerat kommunikationsarbete
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att skriva, redigera och målgruppsanpassa innehåll
* Erfarenhet av webbpublicering och digitala kommunikationskanaler


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av kommunikation inom hälso- och sjukvård, universitet eller annan kunskapsintensiv verksamhet
* Erfarenhet av forskningskommunikation
* Förståelse för klinisk forskning, kliniska studier eller forskningsinfrastruktur
* Akademisk bakgrund inom medicin, vårdvetenskap eller annat relevant område
* Erfarenhet av filmning och videoproduktion
* Goda kunskaper i Adobe InDesign och Photoshop
* Kunskap om digital tillgänglighet och WCAG


**Om rekryteringsprocessen**
 Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningstiden.
   

  

 I samband med din ansökan behöver du bifoga CV. Istället för ett personligt brev ber vi dig besvara urvalsfrågor samt kort motivera varför du passar för rollen. Att besvara frågorna är en förutsättning för att din ansökan ska anses komplett.
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan - Tillsammans är vi Karolinska!
   

  

 Inför tillsättning av befattning som innefattar vård av barn och ungdom, kontrolleras den som erbjuds tjänsten mot misstanke- och belastningsregistret. Här kan du läsa mer om rekryteringsprocessen och om vilka kontroller som utförs på Karolinska.
   

  

 Som anställd på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset kan du komma att krigsplaceras. Läs mer om vad det innebär här.
   

  

 Om du är eller tidigare har varit anställd i Region Stockholm kommer vi att ta interna referenser från din nuvarande eller tidigare chef om du blir aktuell för anställning.
   

  

 För tillsvidaretjänster kan provanställning komma att tillämpas.
   

  

**Om Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset**
 Vi på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset är stolta över att vi är ett av världens främsta universitetssjukhus. Förutom vårt särskilda ansvar för den högspecialiserade vården i Stockholmsregionen är huvuduppdraget att tillsammans med Karolinska Institutet utbilda framtidens vårdanställda och bedriva världsledande forskning samtidigt som vi fortsätter vårt arbete med att utveckla vården för patientens bästa. Vi arbetar inom en rad olika områden och professioner.
   

  

 Du kan läsa mer om vårt uppdrag inom vård, forskning och utbildning här.
   

  

 Vår vision - Vi ska bota och lindra imorgon det ingen kan bota och lindra idag.
   

  

 Läs gärna mer om oss på karolinska.se och följ oss på sociala medier!
   

  

**Forskning och Utbildning**
 För att stödja sjukhusets alla kliniska verksamheter arbetar jurister, ekonomer, kommunikatörer, HR, Inköpare och IT för att vi tillsammans ska generera vård i världsklass och vara en verkligt Attraktiv Arbetsgivare!
   

  

 Här kan du läsa mer om oss.
   

  

**Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm**
 Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.
   

  

 Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  

 Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.
   

  

 Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion.
   

  

 Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss i Region Stockholm (öppnas i nytt fönster)

 If you want real autonomy, colleagues who push you, and work that moves the needle from day one, you'll fit right in.

title: UX Designer - DesignOps
description:
We are on a mission to become the leading international force in residential property management. What we do matters to billions of people in their everyday lives.
   

  

 Residential real estate is the world’s largest asset class, and for most families, buying a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long, residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents' expectations, and the industry is ready for change. Odevo was formed to make that change happen.
   

  

 In just six years, Odevo has grown more than 70-fold, establishing us as the leading international player. We are more than 12,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, and Italy building Odevo. Together, we aspire to break new ground through innovation and cultivate a workplace where we help each other succeed, where ideas matter more than titles, and where kindness is a strength.
   

  

 By combining the power of people and technology, we set a new standard for how homes are managed. Our technology-enabled services simplify living for residents and create a better experience for property owners and boards.
   

  

 Our ambition is to continue our fast-growing journey through new customers, service expansion, and by partnering with great companies that share our mindset and ambition, both in existing and new markets.
   

  

 As we continue to grow, we stay true to who we are, challenge unnecessary bureaucracy, and keep decision-making close to our customers.
   

  

 If you share our mindset and ambition, we’d love you to join us and help accelerate our mission together.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a UX Designer with strong AI experience to help shape not only the products we design, but also how design is practiced, specified, scaled, and implemented across our global product organisation.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to join an industry still in an early stage of digital maturity, where you can have a significant impact. We see customer experience as a critical differentiator and an important part of our ambition to transform the global property management industry.
   

  

 You’ll join a global design team led by the Head of CX & UX in Stockholm, Sweden. This role combines hands-on UX and interaction design in our AI team with helping the wider design team scale quality, consistency, design systems, and AI-assisted product development workflows globally. You will collaborate with the global design team and support knowledge sharing across all our markets, including the UK, Europe, the US, and Mexico. As part of this role, you will shape both intuitive customer-facing experiences and complex internal workflows for property management employees.
   

  

 You will help mature how our design team works across markets, products, and disciplines. This includes improving design system structure, documentation, governance, and adoption; defining practical quality standards; and establishing clearer ways of working across Figma, design specifications, no-code tools, and AI-assisted development workflows.
   

  

 AI will be central to how we evolve our design practice going forward, balancing the efficiency of AI agents with the judgement, taste, and craft of experienced designers. Experience in both DesignOps and AI-assisted design and development will therefore be a strong advantage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work and lead the “ordinary” design process within product teams - translating user needs, business goals, and technical constraints into clear flows, prototypes, interaction design to test and learn iteratively.
* Define design practices for agent driven development workflows, and how design artefacts should be specified so they can be used effectively by designers, product managers, engineers, and agents. Eg specification formats, reusable prompts, design skills, MCPs, and validation methods.
* Define how design artefacts — such as user flows, service blueprints, prototypes, component specifications, interaction rules, and acceptance criteria — can better steer and validate AI-assisted implementation.
* Support more efficient research and validation practices, like how we evaluate product iterations and AI-generated outputs against user needs, design system standards, accessibility expectations, and product quality criteria. This includes, for example, defining/creating tools for research planning, recruitment processes, GDPR considerations, research templates, and maintaining a research repository.
* Lead the work with the Odevo design system(s) by improving component documentation, governance, accessibility standards, usage guidance, and alignment between design components/patterns and code.


**Who You Are**
 You are genuinely interested in understanding people’s needs, behaviours, and motivations, and you use that insight to shape services that deliver real value. You combine strong design craft with systems thinking and can move comfortably between user needs, business outcomes, service journeys, and detailed interaction design.
   

  

 You strive for quality, value collaboration over prestige, and enjoy contributing to a strong team culture. You are a strong communicator who can turn research insights and design rationale into shared understanding across teams and stakeholders.
   

  

 You enjoy making design work more legible, scalable, and repeatable. You care about the craft of design, but also about the systems, rituals, documentation, and standards that help teams deliver good design consistently. You are comfortable moving between hands-on product design and improving the underlying ways of working that support the wider design organisation.
   

  

 You are pragmatic about AI: curious and experimental, but also thoughtful about quality, trust, transparency, human oversight, and when AI should or should not be used.
   

  

**Experience**
* 5+ years of experience as a UX Designer, Product Designer, or similar role, working on complex digital products.
* Bachelor’s degree in design, HCI, behavioural science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong proficiency in Figma, prototyping, interaction design, UX research, service design, and design systems.
* Experience designing web and mobile products for complex, data-rich, workflow-heavy, or operational environments.
* Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams with product managers, engineers, designers, and stakeholders.
* Experience contributing to DesignOps and design systems, including documentation, governance, quality standards, tooling, ResearchOps, and alignment between design and code.
* Experience with AI-driven design or development workflows, including how structured specifications, component rules, interaction logic, and acceptance criteria can guide AI-assisted implementation.
* Experience designing AI-enabled product experiences, such as intelligent search, automation, recommendations, copilots, or decision-support tools.
* Property management or proptech experience is a plus.


**What We Offer**
* Professional growth - to work with the most talented developers in the industry.
* Modern technology - we invest in the latest technologies and tools and encourage our team members to share their ideas and take ownership of their work.
* Innovation - to work on exciting projects that push the boundaries of our industry and make a real impact.
* Commitment to quality - a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values profitable and long-term product development.

title: Senior Data Scientist / AI Engineer - Generative AI
description:
**Job ID: 1878**
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist / AI Engineer to build and scale Generative AI applications. The role is permanent based in Stockholm or Helsinki. We work in a hybrid model and expect team members to work three days per week in the office. This is an English-speaking working environment.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You will join Nordea’s AI & Machine Learning team, part of the group financial crime prevention (GFCP) unit that provides financial crime prevention services across Nordea. We use AI to improve how we detect and investigate financial crime across the bank, helping to keep our customers, our company, and society safe. We are a team of about 25 colleagues based in Stockholm, Helsinki and Copenhagen. We have already launched Nordea’s first generative AI product and are now building the next wave of high impact generative AI use cases.
   

  

 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
   

  

**Why this role is exciting**
 This is an opportunity to work on real-world Generative AI applications in a domain where quality, robustness, and responsible AI matter. You will help turn ideas into production-grade AI solutions in financial crime prevention, working closely with business stakeholders and experienced colleagues across the Nordics.
   

  

**In this role, you will**
* Identify and prototype high-impact GenAI projects with business stakeholders
* Build, deploy and monitor production-grade Gen AI applications
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, data) to deliver end-to-end solutions
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks to measure and improve application quality
* Contribute to best practices, tooling and architecture for Generative AI development
* Document models and evaluations to meet risk and compliance standards and ensure responsible use of AI


**Your background and skills:**
* MSc or PhD in Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or related fields. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.

**What We Offer**
 People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.
