 **Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)**
* Enterprise experience with
 **HiveMQ broker administration**
* Strong Linux experience
* Experience with
 **GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins**
* Experience with
 **ArgoCD**
* Strong experience with
 **Helm**
* Infrastructure as Code experience using
 **Terraform or equivalent**
* Experience with
 **PostgreSQL**
* Strong understanding of Kafka security, performance tuning and cluster administration
* Experience with
 **Splunk, Grafana and Prometheus**
* Experience with
 **Fluent Bit or OpenTelemetry**



  





**Nice to have:** 



* Experience with
 **API Management / APIM**
* Multi-cloud experience across Azure, AWS or Google Cloud
* Cloud cost optimisation experience
* Experience working within an
 **Integration Platform, Core Platform or Platform Engineering** 
 organisation
* Experience with Envoy Gateway or similar edge/proxy technologies
* Swedish language skills



**Fluent English is required. Swedish is an advantage.**

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Europe's public institutions serve hundreds of millions of people, and most lack the AI infrastructure to do it well. Intric is changing that. Our sovereign AI platform is already used by 70+ municipalities, governments, and institutions. We've built a leading position in Sweden and are expanding across Europe.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Be the technical owner within customer engagements, working alongside sales and customer success from pre-sales through go-live
* Build integrations across APIs, authentication systems, data pipelines, and document platforms
* Deploy Intric in on-prem and private cloud environments with strict security requirements
* Debug what no one else can figure out, in environments with limited tooling and high constraints
* Turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions customers rely on daily
* Prioritize ruthlessly across competing demands, from a position of knowledge rather than whoever is loudest
* Feed real-world deployment insights back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap


**Who you are**
 You've shipped things that other people depend on. You've been on-call when they broke. You've dealt with real production risk, real failure, and end-to-end ownership without a safety net. That background is what makes the rest of this possible.
   

  

* You work across the full stack without needing to hand off: frontend, backend, infrastructure, AI layer, GitOps, networking, protocols, raw API work
* You take ownership of customer outcomes, not individual tasks. If the customer isn't reaching their goal, that's your problem to solve.
* You can say no to the wrong thing and yes to the right one, even under pressure from the customer.
* You can explain a technical decision to a non-technical department manager and defend it to their engineers, often in the same meeting
* You're effective in ambiguous, under-documented, high-constraint environments


**Fluent** 
**Swedish and English are both required for this role.**
 Your title might have been Implementation Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or something else entirely. What matters is what you actually did: owning delivery in customer environments, end to end, with real stakes attached.
   

  

**What You'll Gain**
 You'll build a combination that's hard to find elsewhere: production-level AI deployment experience in high-security environments, across multiple industries, with direct ownership of customer outcomes from start to finish.
   

  

* Hands-on experience deploying AI in production-critical, high-security environments
* Exposure to complex enterprise architectures across sectors and countries
* Direct influence on product direction through real deployment feedback


**What this job actually looks like**
**Up to 80% of your work happens in customer environments, alongside their technical teams primarly across Sweden with some cross-Nordics travel as projects require** 
 . You learn their systems, integrate the platform, and own the outcome from the first sales conversation through go-live and beyond.
   

  

 The environment spans Python, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, self-hosted LLMs, and Svelte. You won't use all of it on every project, but you need to move across the stack as the situation demands. You use AI tools well and quickly, but your value is the judgment behind them: knowing what to build, how to prioritize, and when to push back.
   

  

 Your default is finding the path, not describing the obstacle. Sometimes that means telling a customer that what they're asking for is the wrong thing to build. Both are part of the job.
   

  

**Why Intric**
* One of Europe's most trusted AI platforms for regulated organizations
* Funded and growing: you're joining before the scale curve, not after
* High ownership and decision-making authority from day one
* A team that takes quality, security, and long-term trust seriously


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and equity
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension) with fund choice and advisory meetings, plus sjukförsäkring, premiebefrielse, TFA, and TGL
* 25 days paid vacation
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)

title: Principal Services Solutions Manager - Federal
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


Snowflake are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer for the Nordic market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.


As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

**In this role you will get to:**
---------------------------------

* Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers
* Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation
* Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win
* Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects
* Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them
* Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing
* Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events
* Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful
* Proactively contribute and help co-develop Account & territory plans and execute while engaging with the broader internal/external ecosystem.

**On day one you we will expect you to have:**
----------------------------------------------

* Solution engineering/solution architect experience in a Saas environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)
* Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos
* Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology
* Hands on experience with SQL
* Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions
* Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

**Preferred (but not required) to have:**
-----------------------------------------

* Experience with global & strategic accounts
* Experience with AI, data science and machine learning technologies


People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solution Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.


Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.


Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.


How do you want to make your impact?


For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

title: Mid Market Inside Sales Specialist - Infrastructure Solutions (UK)
description:
### **General Information**

Req #
100017468
Career area:
Sales
Country/Region:
Sweden
City:
Solna
Date:
Thursday, August 13, 2026
**Additional Locations**:
* United Kingdom


### **Why Work at Lenovo**

We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.  

  

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

title: Nattreceptionist Scandic Kramer, deltid 83%
description:
Ansök nu
* Ansök senast: 31 augusti 2026
* Malmö
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

**Nu söker vi en Nattreceptionist till Scandic Kramer.**



Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass. Som receptionist på natten arbetar man ensam för att säkerställa att våra gäster har en underbar vistelse hos oss.


Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!



Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad är innebär rollen?**



Du som arbetar i receptionen är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Ser till att gästens önskemål uppfylls. Du har alltid ett leende på läpparna och en kreativ lösning i bakfickan. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. Din arbetsplats är vår lobby. För det är där du möter flest gäster. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning.


Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet och försäljning i fokus.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och denna tjänsten är huvudsakligen på natten. Arbets pass på dagtid kan förekomma.


**Vem är du?**



För att passa i rollen tror vi att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster.



Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


Allra viktigast är dock dina personliga egenskaper och din inställning. För att passa i rollen behöver du vara en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.


**Information om tjänsten**



Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på deltid men tillträde från den 1/9 eller överenskommelse.


Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av ett enklare test om service vid urvalet.



Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till oss på Scandic!



Ps. på vår hemsida kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, vad tjänsten innebär och om våra förmåner!

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Inriver is the AI-powered Product Information Management (PIM) platform that helps brands, manufacturers, and retailers turn product data into a growth engine. Inriver connects seamlessly to upstream systems and downstream channels, enabling continuous optimization of product experiences across every touchpoint, and is trusted by more than 1,600 global brands. Our customers — from B2B manufacturers to global retailers — rely on Inriver to manage massive, complex product catalogs and get them to market faster, with less manual rework.**  

  

**About the role:**


We are now looking for a **Senior Forward Deployed Engineer** to join our team in Malmo to lead technical engagements with our most strategic and complex customers. This is a role for someone who can walk into ambiguous, high-pressure enterprise environments and design the right solution — not just execute someone else's plan. This is a new role within our Engineering team, and we’re looking to hire two Senior Forward Deployed Engineers in Malmö and two in the US.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own the technical architecture and delivery strategy for our largest and most complex customer engagements, from discovery through go-live and expansion
* Act as the senior technical advisor to customer engineering and IT leadership — often CTOs, VPs of Digital, or Heads of Data — on how Inriver fits into their broader systems landscape
* Design and build complex, high-leverage integrations and workflows on top of Inriver's platform, connecting it to ERP/PLM systems (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics), DAM, and downstream commerce/syndication channels
* Model elastic, enterprise-scale product data structures (categories, attributes, relationships, localization) for customers with significant catalogue complexity or regulatory requirements
* Lead rapid prototyping efforts to de-risk onboarding, migrations, and pilots for customers with the highest data volume or complexity
* Write production-quality code - platform enhancements, connectors, extensions, internal tools — while also knowing when to bring in additional engineering support and how to scope that work
* Mentor and technically guide other Forward Deployed Engineers, reviewing their solution designs and unblocking them on hard problems
* Serve as a senior technical voice of the customer internally, shaping product and platform roadmap decisions based on patterns across strategic accounts
* Own escalated production issues, leading real-time debugging efforts alongside customer engineering teams
* Travel to customer sites as needed (expect ~20–40% travel depending on account load)

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------


We don’t expect you to tick every box - but we think you’ll succeed here if you have many of the below:


️7+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, or a related technical/customer-facing role, including experience owning complex technical engagements


️Deep coding skills in at least one modern language (e.g., Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, C#), with the judgment to know when to build vs. when to advise


️Extensive experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and enterprise integration patterns (ETL, middleware, iPaaS) at scale


️Track record of leading technical relationships with enterprise customers — comfortable being the senior voice in the room with customer executives


️Strong ability to reason about complex data models — attributes, taxonomies, relationships — and how they map to messy, real-world enterprise catalogues


️Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers, even without formal management responsibility


️A bias toward action balanced with the judgment to architect for scale and maintainability, not just the immediate fix


️Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate fluidly between deep technical detail and executive-level strategy


️Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and modern deployment practices at enterprise scale


️High comfort with ambiguity and the ability to bring structure to messy, high-stakes customer environments  

  

**Nice to have:**

* Prior experience with a PIM, MDM, DAM, or product data platform
* Deep experience integrating with ERP or PLM systems
* Experience with ecommerce/marketplace syndication at scale
* Familiarity with compliance-heavy product domains
* Prior experience in a senior forward-deployed, solutions architecture, or professional services leadership role at an enterprise SaaS company
* Experience contributing to pre-sales or solutioning for large enterprise deals

### **Why Inriver**

At Inriver, you’ll join a global company with a product at the centre - and people who genuinely care about building something meaningful together. For this role you will also have ownership of the most technically and strategically important customer relationships in the company, direct line of influence into product and platform roadmap decisions and a seat at the table with both customer executives and product leadership.


In our Malmö office, you’ll find things like:

* Tuesday Fika
* Friday breakfasts to start the day together
* A running club and social activities for anyone who wants to join
* A welcoming mix of focused work, collaboration, and a few laughs along the way


We work in a hybrid setup, with flexibility and trust as a baseline.

**Ready to apply?**
-------------------

We’d love to hear from you. If you’re curious but not 100% sure, we still encourage you to apply. We’re happy to explore the fit together!

title: Product Manager
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.


A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.


**Job Summary**
---------------

Flex Power Modules, a business line of Flex, is a leading design and solution provider of scalable DC/DC power converters primarily serving Datacenter markets. Offering a wide range of both isolated and non-isolated solutions, its digitally enabled DC/DC converters include PMBus compatibility supported by the powerful Flex Power Designer. We’re offering solutions for various markets, such as Datacom telecom, and industrial. Further information can be found at flexpowermodules.com or on LinkedIn.


Flex intends to spin off its Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment into a new, independent publicly traded company, which we’re calling SpinCo, until the name is unveiled. The spin is planned for Q1 2027. If the intended spin occurs, this role will support SpinCo, which will focus on critical digital infrastructure, delivering end-to-end power and thermal management solutions for AI data centers and other mission-critical applications.


Flex Power Modules is seeking a Product Manager to manage and develop our portfolio of AI and Datacenter power products. Based in our growing Kalmar Design Center, you will play a key role in shaping product strategy, driving roadmap execution, and ensuring our solutions meet evolving customer and market needs. This position combines technical expertise with strong business acumen and cross-functional leadership across engineering, operations, supply chain, and commercial teams.


**What a Typical Day Looks Like**

* Develop and execute product roadmaps aligned with customer requirements and business objectives.
* Define product specifications and features in close collaboration with Engineering, Marketing, and Sales teams.
* Conduct market analysis to identify long term industry trends, customer needs, and competitive positioning.
* Product ownership from concept through launch and lifecycle management.
* Lead cross-functional teams involving R&D, NPI, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Operations, and Manufacturing.
* Monitor product performance and implement improvements based on customer feedback and market developments.
* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure alignment and effective communication.

**The Experience We're Looking To Add To Our Team**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in Product Management, Project Management, or a similar role.
* Experience in AI, Datacenter, Telecommunications, or related technology sectors is preferred.
* Technical understanding of complex electronic products, ideally DC/DC power conversion technologies.
* Strong commercial mindset with a passion for technology and innovation.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent English language skills; Swedish is considered an advantage.

**What You'll Receive for the Great Work You Provide**

* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge power solutions supporting AI, Datacenter, and Telecom applications.
* A collaborative, innovative, and globally connected work environment.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities within a rapidly expanding business.
* The chance to contribute to technologies that power the next generation of digital infrastructure

A career at Flex Power Modules offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We are seeking a skilled Rack Install Technician to join our Infrastructure Delivery team. The successful candidate will be responsible for installing and cabling server racks as well as fulfilling prerequisites for the Rack Install process.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Server rack installation

  

* Testing and verification of installed equipment

  

* Following detailed technical documentation and installation procedures

  

* Maintain accurate documentation of installations and modifications

  

* Follow safety protocols and data center security procedures

  

* Collaborate with team members and other technical staff

  

About the team  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship & Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in telecommunications or network infrastructure.
* Experience with cable installation and management.
* Knowledge of server systems and power infrastructure.
* Ability to work in various positions (working on ladders, etc).
* Valid driver's license.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Associate's degree in telecommunications or related field.
* Experience with fiber optic installations.
* Knowledge of network protocols and architectures.
* Knowledge of power distribution units (PDUs).

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Application Architect
description:
I’m Irmantas Petrauskas, leading the Service Order Management and Activation team, which focuses on building next-generation service orchestration across Telia’s footprint.


Right now, we’re looking for a passionate and visionary Application Architect to join our journey, with a focus on Service Order Management (SOM). This role is key to designing the systems that power seamless service delivery across mobile, fixed, and converged networks.


Whether you're based in the Nordics, the Baltics, or beyond, if you have a deep understanding of telecommunications services and OSS applications, along with a passion for architecture, we want to hear from you.


**What you’ll do**

You will be responsible for shaping the application architecture for Service Order Management, ensuring consistent design and effective collaboration across teams, domains, and vendors.


* Define and maintain the application and service architecture for Service Order Management.
* Lead solution design across initiatives, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and TM Forum standards.
* Analyze requirements for new capabilities and create high- and low-level design documentation.
* Apply security-by-design principles and ensure compliance with architectural governance.
* Collaborate with BSS, NSO, Inventory, SIM management, and external vendors to ensure quality and performance across the SOM ecosystem.

**What will help you thrive in this role:**

You are a forward-thinking and collaborative problem solver who is comfortable working across technical domains, teams, and vendors. You understand how architecture decisions influence service delivery and customer experience, and you can balance the bigger picture with attention to technical detail.


* Experience in OSS architecture, particularly Service Order Management, service orchestration, Inventory, or SIM/eSIM lifecycle management.
* Understanding of catalog-driven orchestration and how SOM integrates with other BSS and OSS domains.
* Experience with requirements analysis and high- and low-level solution design.
* Knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs.
* Knowledge of microservices, REST APIs, Kubernetes, CI/CD, cloud-native platforms, and automation.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in an international agile environment.

**It is an advantage if you also have knowledge of:**

* Leading architecture work across complex transformation initiatives.
* SAFe or other agile ways of working.
* Working with major telecommunications technology vendors.

**Join us to shape smarter living for people, businesses, and the planet**

At Telia, we’re a team of 15 000 colleagues across the Nordics and Baltics, passionate about technology and connectivity. As a Top Employer and Sustainability Leader, we drive change with large-scale, impactful projects while building a sustainable, inclusive world. Here, you can grow your skills, lead meaningful projects, and thrive in a supportive, diverse environment. Whether you’re taking your first step or your next, Telia is a place to grow, belong, and make a real impact.


**What we offer**

When you join us, you'll receive a comprehensive benefits package tailored to your local market, opportunities for remote work, and more. You'll also have the chance to earn a bonus based on your performance and Telia's results.


*For Lithuanian candidates only:* *monthly salary range for this position: 4,300–6,400 Eur (gross) + annual performance. Although it may vary depending on your skills and experience.*

**Ready to make better happen?**

We look forward to receiving your application by **2026-08-20** . Please note that we might close the position earlier if we find the right candidate, so don’t wait too long to apply!


If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our Hiring Manager/Talent Acquisition Partner. Background and reference checks will be part of the process.


**Equal opportunities**

At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where your uniqueness is our strength.


**Join us and let’s make better happen - together!**

description:

Affärsområdet har sin tyngdpunkt inom lösningar och tjänster baserade på marknadsledande teknologier från Cisco, Everpure och Red Hat, där vi hjälper kunder att bygga moderna, säkra och automatiserade plattformar för datacenter, privata moln och hybridmoln.
  

Det här är en strategisk ledarroll för dig som kombinerar affärsmannaskap med starkt ledarskap och en djup förståelse för modern infrastruktur och molnteknologi.

* Leda, utveckla och inspirera ledare och specialister inom området.
* Identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och vidareutveckla vårt kunderbjudande.

* Utveckla partnerskap med ledande teknikleverantörer.
* Bidra till Conscias övergripande strategi och marknadsposition.

  
Vi tror att du är en erfaren ledare med dokumenterad förmåga att skapa tillväxt, bygga högpresterande team och utveckla affärer inom IT-infrastruktur, molntjänster eller närliggande områden.
  

Du har sannolikt:
  

* Flerårig erfarenhet av personal- och resultatansvar.
* Erfarenhet av att leda specialistorganisationer eller konsultverksamhet.
* God förståelse för hybrid cloud, datacenter, automatisering och moderna plattformstjänster.
* Stark kommersiell förmåga och vana att arbeta nära kunder och partners.
* Erfarenhet av förändringsledning och verksamhetsutveckling.
* Förmåga att kombinera strategiskt tänkande med operativt genomförande.

Som person är du engagerande, tydlig och prestigelös. Du bygger förtroende, skapar riktning och får människor att växa.
  
På Conscia samlar vi några av marknadens främsta specialister inom cybersecurity, networking, hybrid cloud och observability. Vi tror på att dela kunskap, utvecklas tillsammans och ge våra medarbetare frihet under ansvar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka på riktigt, både för våra kunder och för organisationens framtid.
  

Hos oss får du:
  

* Ett strategiskt uppdrag med stort inflytande.
* Möjlighet att leda marknadens främsta specialister.
* En kultur som präglas av kunskapsdelning, samarbete och entreprenörskap.
* Flexibilitet och förtroende i hur du leder och arbetar.
* Möjlighet att vara med och bygga framtidens digitala infrastruktur.

  

**Secure your progress**  

Vi tror att utveckling sker när människor får möjlighet att växa, påverka och göra skillnad. Om du vill kombinera affärsutveckling, ledarskap och teknik i en av branschens mest spännande roller vill vi gärna höra från dig.

title: Receptionist Scandic Växjö, extra vid behov
description:
Ansök nu
* Ansök senast: 13 september 2026
* Växjö
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

Ett par svängar in från E4:an ligger Scandic Växjö- mitt emot stadens största shoppingcenter och några minuters promenad från Arena Staden. Här kan våra gäster simma i inomhuspoolen, äta en god middag i Köksbaren eller ta en drink i vår lobbybar.


Vi lägger stor vikt vid ett personligt, trevligt och välkomnande bemötande- mot våra gäster så klart men också mot varandra. Våra utvecklingsmöjligheter på hotellet sträcker sig längre än över avdelningsgränserna. Vi är ett stort gäng med snabba steg som är måna om att inspirera varandra så att alla ska trivas med sitt arbete på vårt spännande hotell.


**Nu söker vi en Receptionist till Scandic Växjö.**



Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.



Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!



Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad är innebär rollen?**



Du som arbetar i receptionen är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Ser till att gästens önskemål uppfylls. Du har alltid ett leende på läpparna och en kreativ lösning i bakfickan. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. Din arbetsplats är vår lobby. För det är där du möter flest gäster. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning.


Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet och försäljning i fokus.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och det är därför viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i skift (förmiddagar, eftermiddagar och helger).


**Vem är du?**



För att passa i rollen tror vi att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster.



Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


Allra viktigast är dock dina personliga egenskaper och din inställning. För att passa i rollen behöver du vara en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.


**Information om tjänsten**



Tjänsten är en anställning för enstaka dagar på extra vid behov.


Platsen omfattar kvälls- och dagskift på vardagar och helger.


Startdatum så snart som möjligt..


Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av ett enklare test om service vid urvalet.



Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till oss på Scandic!



Ps. på vår hemsida kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, vad tjänsten innebär och om våra förmåner!

title: Customer Support Agent to TaxiCaller
description:
TaxiCaller is on a mission to transform the transportation industry, providing cloud-based dispatch and booking solutions to taxi and transport companies around the world. We’re growing steadily, profitable, and supporting customers across multiple continents every day.
  
We are now looking for a new Customer Support Agent to join our team in Linköping.
  
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys structure, organisation and working in a fast-moving software environment, even if you don’t come from a technical background.
  
  

About the role
  
In this role, you’ll support our customer support organisation with a mix of operational, administrative and support-related tasks that help keep things running smoothly behind the scenes.
  
Your daily work will include customer account administration, onboarding-related tasks, quality assurance checks and helping maintain internal documentation and support resources. You’ll also assist different teams with follow-ups, coordination and general operational support when needed.
  
The role is ideal for someone who is organised, detail-oriented and comfortable working with modern software and digital tools. You do not need a technical education or previous experience in software development, but you should feel comfortable using computers, email systems, mobile devices and online platforms.
  
This is considered an entry-level position, and we care more about mindset, reliability and willingness to learn than formal qualifications.
  
  

**We think you’ll fit well in this role if you:**  

* Are organised and pay strong attention to detail.
* Enjoy structured tasks and working methodically.
* Are curious and interested in learning how software platforms work.
* Communicate clearly and professionally in English, both verbally and in writing.
* Are comfortable working with computers and mobile applications.

title: Manager, Sales Development
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


We are looking for a **Partner Solution Engineer** who is accustomed to working with Partners and Systems Integrators. In this role, you will work directly with our consulting & SI partners, enabling them on key platform features and their business benefits and helping them to grow their Snowflake services business and shape their go-to-market.


As a Snowflake Partner Solution Engineer, you must share our passion for innovating through the AI Data Cloud, thrive in a dynamic environment, and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and inspiring technical audiences.

  

### **IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:**

* Present Snowflake technology and vision to decision makers and technical contributors at partners, prospects and customers
* Work hands-on with partners and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle
* Build technical champions within our partners and grow the local Snowflake technical community
* Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  

### **ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:**

* 4 years of industry experience with a minimum of 2 within a pre-sales environment working directly with consulting & System Integration (GSI/RSI) partners
* Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos
* Broad range of experience within large-scale Database and/or Data Warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud technologies
* Hands-on expertise with SQL
* Experience in data science is highly desirable as is hands-on Python experience
* Ability to connect specific business problems and Snowflake’s solutions
* University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred
* Fluency in English required

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.


How do you want to make your impact?


For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

title: Lead Cloud Security Architect
description:
**We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!**
 As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Lead Cloud Security Architect is a senior, influential role responsible for orchestrating and leading Arrive’s global cloud security strategy. As a core member of the Security Architecture & Engineering team, you will act as the central driver for how we design, build, and govern our multi-cloud infrastructure across the company.
   

  

 Your primary focus is to unite our efforts by creating, standardizing, and scaling our cloud security posture globally. This involves building upon existing expertise and forging a powerful partnership with the Infrastructure and Platform Engineering teams to ensure our next generation of products is built on a resilient, secure-by-design foundation.
   

  

**Your mission**
 To elevate and unify our cloud security program at Arrive. Your mission is to be a force-multiplier for our infrastructure and engineering teams, fostering a secure cloud culture built on clear global standards, strong partnerships, and modern automation. You will ensure that cloud security is a shared goal and a collective achievement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Security Strategy & Standards**
* Champion and orchestrate the definition of Arrive’s cloud security architecture, from identity boundaries to network segmentation, in partnership with Data & Analytics teams, Engineering, and IT.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive set of global security standards, baselines, and guidelines for cloud-native services, container security, and serverless computing.
* Create and champion the strategy for cloud security tooling including CSPM (Cloud Security Posture Management) and CWPP (Cloud Workload Protection) - ensuring these platforms are architected for seamless SecOps integration, automated alerting, and streamlined incident response workflows.
* Define and manage cloud security standards for Mergers & Acquisitions, establishing requirements for the secure migration and integration of acquired cloud environments.
* Own and evolve the cloud security reference architecture, providing a clear 'north star' for all engineering teams to follow.


**Technical Partnership & Enablement**
* Operating 'Together,' you will act as strategic partner for the Infrastructure, SecOps, and engineering teams, orchestrating a cohesive security vision that spans the entire cloud and AI-first engineering landscape.
* Act as a lead security consultant and strategic partner for infrastructure, SecOps, and Engineering teams - providing expert guidance on secure cloud design patterns and landing zone configurations.
* Forge a dynamic partnership with the Security Platform team: co-design the infrastructure-as-code (IaC) security roadmap and introduce new architectural patterns where needed.
* Lead security architecture reviews and threat modeling sessions for complex cloud migrations and high-risk infrastructure changes.
* Act as a senior mentor and advocate for cloud security champions across the organization, helping to grow our internal technical talent.


**Emerging Threats & Innovation**
* Stay ‘Curious’ at the forefront of emerging cloud-based threats, with a particular focus on the risks associated with multi-cloud sprawl and shadow IT.
* Drive innovation in security practices by seeking opportunities to automate and improve the effectiveness of our cloud detection and response capabilities.
* Lead the strategy for leveraging AI to mature our cloud governance.


**What You Bring**
* Deep Cloud Expertise: Extensive, hands-on experience in cloud security, with mastery of identity management, network security, and data protection in the cloud.
* A Builder of Standards: Proven experience creating and rolling out security standards and patterns in a complex, multi-cloud environment.
* A Unifier and Partner: Exceptional ability to foster collaboration and influence infrastructure teams without direct authority; you build bridges and break down silos.
* Strategic Thinker: Ability to define a long-term strategy for cloud security and translate it into an actionable, scalable plan.
* Modern Technologist: Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, containerization, and Infrastructure as Code.
* An Automation- and AI-First Mindset: You believe that manual processes are a liability. You constantly seek opportunities to codify standards, automate controls, and embed security directly into the engineering workflow, reducing friction and improving velocity.


**Qualifications**
* 10+ years of experience in technology, with at least 7 years in a dedicated cloud security or infrastructure security role.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing secure landing zones in a multi-cloud environment (GCP, AWS).
* Hands-on experience with the architecture and strategy of cloud security tools (e.g.,Wiz, Orca).
* A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience.


**Why join Arrive**
* Be the global leader and define the future of cloud security at a mission-driven, transformative company.
* Operate as a senior expert within a strategic architecture team, with a broad mandate to influence security across all of Arrive’s infrastructure.
* Work at the cutting edge of securing technology, including multi-cloud and AI-driven mobility solutions.


**This is a hybrid role. We welcome candidates based in** 
**Sweden, United Kingdom or Poland.**
 Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

title: Senior Security Operation Engineer
description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

**Senior Security Operations Engineer**
 We are seeking a hands-on Senior Security Operations Engineer to operate and improve key enterprise security platforms across endpoint, server, network, and secure access environments. * Experience in troubleshooting network, VPN, and SASE-related issues in enterprise environments.

title: Manager, Solutions Engineering | NorBen | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Manager of Solutions Engineering for the NEMEA region at Grafana Labs, you will be responsible for all aspects of building and managing a team of high performing Solution Engineers. You will own the regional build-out with your sales leader counterparts, adopting existing OSS Specific GTM strategies and developing new ones as needed. You’ll work with your Customer Experience counterparts to ensure that your customers are successful after the sale, in their adoption and rollout of Grafana products through professional services, support, training and customer success. You’ll work with marketing to drive community and adoption programs in the region designed to broaden the adoption of both OSS and commercial/cloud versions of our products. You’ll also work closely with Product Management and Engineering to ensure that we are constantly delivering value to our customers by influencing the roadmap, based on your customers and team feedback, as well as leveraging your own experience in the Monitoring and Observability space. All of this will be required for you to hit and then exceed your region's financial targets and ultimately, our company's goals. Your impact will be felt globally when the job is done well.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Attract, recruit, ramp and mentor a team of great Presales SE’s from diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* Get the best out of your team with a servant based leadership approach. Adopting a player/coach mentality will be critical here, ensuring that you balance your field responsibilities with the needs of your team. Mentoring and career development will be critical to your team's success over the long term
* Direct the bulk of your day to day work based on guidance and goals from leadership, owning the planning, actions and outcomes of the region.
* Partner with the Benelux / NEMEA Sales leadership on customer programs, marketing initiatives and community/company events to drive adoption and expansion within our customer base.
* Executive sponsorship of key accounts in the region will be key to your success. Being a thought leader/partner to your customers and the company within EMEA.
* Understanding your key customers’ strategies for adoption of Grafana technologies and developing programs and collateral to enable them to be successful.
* Ensure that your customers’ requirements are being met with our product through partnership with Product Management and Engineering, helping them prioritize their team's time with a data-driven approach to wins/losses/needs vs wants, etc.
* Own and report on the quarter over quarter cadence of your team while they help prospects evaluate our software with demonstrations, technical deep dives, trials and POVs.
* Find and drive enablement and sell with/through channel partners in the region. Both at a local, geo and global level with both RSI’s and GSI’s.


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* Some experience leading a team, 5-10 years in the high tech industry having held roles such as Developer, Architect, Sales Engineer/Architect, Manager, etc.
* Proven success working in a fast-paced, high growth startup environment that is remote-first
* Proven track record of mentoring, developing people and managing performance over time. Has successfully mentored individual contributors.
* Open Source selling or Cloud first/Product led sales go to market motion a big plus.
* Direct experience implementing and/or executing a formal sales methodology, eg COM, Value selling, qualification frameworks like MEDDPICC
* Direct experience selling monitoring/data/visualisation products.
* Proven ability to own a book of business, direct your own and your team's work and initiatives to exceed your quarterly targets.
* English fluency required, and a second European language is preferred
* Located in Sweden


 In Sweden, the OTE compensation range for this role is SEK 1,480,000 - SEK 1,775,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable), and other benefits listed on our careers page.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*

title: IT Risk Manager
description:
*Nu söker vi en strukturerad och initiativrik IT Risk Manager som vill bidra till att skapa en trygg, hållbar och innovativ IT-miljö inom Länsförsäkringar AB. Hos oss får du en nyckelroll där du både får driva och utveckla vårt arbete med IT-risk – och samtidigt vara med och påverka införandet av ett nytt GRC-verktyg som kommer förändra hur vi arbetar med IKT-risk framöver.* 




  





**Om jobbet** 




 I denna nyckelroll får du möjlighet att driva och utveckla arbetet med IT-riskhantering inom hela vår verksamhet. Du blir en central spelare i att säkerställa att vi har moderna, effektiva och hållbara processer för riskhantering – i linje med koncernens strategi och internationella standarder. Du kommer att arbeta nära både IT, verksamhet och ledning och får stor möjlighet att påverka hur vi arbetar med IKT-risk framöver, inte minst genom att digitalisera ITs riskbedömningar. Du kommer vara del av Digital och IT:s GRC team där arbetet sker i nära samverkan mellan Governance, Risk och Compliance.
 



  





 Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer vara bland annat:
 


* Äga och vidareutveckla IT-riskramverk, policyer och processer enligt relevanta standarder.
* Driva och facilitera RCSA, riskworkshops
* Säkerställa riskbedömningar i förändringsråd och utvecklingsflöden.
* Hantera koncentrationsrisk, exitstrategier och avtalsmässiga kontroller.
* Bedöma risker relaterade till molnplattformar (AWS/Azure/GCP), Kubernetes/kontainrar, IAM/PAM, KMS, loggning/SIEM.
* Samverka kring sårbarhetshantering, patchprocess, undantag och riskacceptans och rotorsaksanalyser.
* Koordinera krav och gap mot regelverk (NIS2, DORA, GDPR etc.), stödja audits och granskningar.
* Etablera och följa KRI:er och kontrollmått, rapportera till ledning, riskkommitté och styrelse.
* Höja riskmognad genom riktade utbildningar, stödmaterial och coachning, samt fungera som ”översättare” mellan teknik och verksamhet.



  





**Vem är du?** 




 Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst:
 


* Akademisk utbildning inom IT, finans eller motsvarande.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av dedikerat arbete inom IT riskhantering
* Erfarenhet från bank, försäkring eller annan reglerad verksamhet.
* Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.
* Förmåga att bygga nätverk och samarbeta effektivt inom organisationen.



  





 Meriterande är även om du har:
 


* Certifieringar inom risk och säkerhet, exempelvis CRISC, CISM, CISSP, CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor, CGEIT, FAIR Analyst, CCSK/CCSP, CIPP/E.
* Erfarenhet av införande av GRC/IRM-plattformar inklusive datamodell och integrationer.
* Erfarenhet av SOC2/ISO 27001-program
* Kännedom om SRE/chaos engineering och hur detta kopplas till risk och resiliens.
* Grundläggande teknikförståelse inom nätverk, kryptografi, API-säkerhet och containerhärdning.



  





 Som person är du analytisk och har lätt för att snabbt sätta dig in i komplexa IT-miljöer och identifiera risker. Du bygger relationer och samarbetar effektivt med både IT, verksamhet och ledning. Du är kommunikativ och kan förklara risker och åtgärder på ett pedagogiskt sätt för olika målgrupper. Med stark initiativförmåga driver du riskhanteringsfrågor proaktivt och föreslår förbättringar innan problem uppstår.

title: Reliability Engineer
description:
****What we do at Blykalla****
*Blykalla is a Swedish deep-tech company at the forefront of the nuclear industry, pioneering the development of small modular reactors that provide clean, safe, and reliable energy. Thanks to lead-cooling, we achieve high safety in a very compact format, allowing for a simple and cost-effective design that can be mass-produced. Our unique reactor design will provide safe and green baseload energy that perfectly complements solar and wind powe* 
 r.
   

  

****Main purpose and responsibility****
 You own reliability, availability, and maintainability (RAM) engineering for Blykalla’s SEALER-55 lead-cooled fast reactor (LFR), a 55MW small modular reactor, working within Plant Engineering across assigned plant areas, systems, and work packages. Your focus is quantitative reliability analysis - RAM and availability modeling, reliability block diagrams, fault trees, reliability data analysis, and FMEA / FMECA - for a nuclear plant, in close support of the probabilistic safety assessment (PSA) that underpins the safety case. You set up the reliability framework - the RAM, FMEA, and FMECA methods, templates, criticality criteria, and data basis - and then execute against it, making sure availability and reliability targets are defined, modeled, and flowed down into design, redundancy and sparing, testing, and maintenance requirements. You quantify how design and maintenance choices affect availability and lifecycle performance, coordinate interfaces with other disciplines and suppliers, and support the project from design through procurement, construction, and handover to commissioning and operations. You also help shape a plant-as-a-product mindset through standardization, modular design, and DfMA.
   

  

****What you’ll get to do****
 You are responsible for contributing to Blykalla’s plant engineering capability by incorporating the areas below into your daily work:
   

  

**Ownership and modeling approach**
* Set up the RAM, FMEA, and FMECA framework - methods, templates, criticality criteria, and data basis - then own and execute the RAM scope for your areas (availability and reliability targets, redundancy and sparing philosophy, analysis basis), planning deliverables, priorities, and resource needs.
* Define and maintain the reliability design basis, RAM targets, modeling methodology, data sources, and assumptions, working directly in RiskSpectrum (required) for fault tree and PSA-aligned modeling, together with RAM tools such as ReliaSoft, Isograph, GRIF, or Maros / Taro.
* Build and maintain reliability block diagrams, fault trees, and Markov / Monte-Carlo availability models, and flow reliability, availability, and maintainability requirements down to specifications and data sheets.


**Reliability, availability, and maintainability analysis**
* Perform and review RAM and availability studies, including RBD and fault tree analysis, Monte-Carlo simulation, spares and logistics modeling, and lost-production analysis.
* Perform FMEA / FMECA, reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), and criticality ranking to drive design, redundancy, monitoring, and maintenance decisions.
* Quantify the availability and lifecycle impact of design, redundancy, maintenance and test intervals, and sparing, and track margin against targets.
* Establish reliability data and failure-rate estimates from sources such as ISO 14224 / OREDA, including Weibull / life-data analysis and common-cause parameters.
* Provide reliability inputs - component failure data, common-cause factors, and test and maintenance assumptions - to the nuclear PSA and safety case, coordinating closely with the function that owns nuclear safety.


**Interfaces and integration**
* Coordinate interfaces across disciplines - process, mechanical, rotating equipment, electrical, I&C, civil and structural, layout, safety and licensing, and operations and maintenance.
* Resolve issues around redundancy, single points of failure, common-cause vulnerabilities, testability, maintainability, and access for maintenance, and support 3D model and design reviews.
* Suppliers, delivery, and change control
* Set reliability and maintainability requirements for RFQs and supplier packages (targets, RAM data, FMECA, reliability demonstration) and review supplier reliability data and reports.
* Give reliable input to estimates, schedules, risk reviews, and change requests - including the availability impact of changes - and escalate technical risks early with practical mitigations.
* Support design, safety, and constructability reviews, RFI responses, site queries, and field changes.


**Team development and ways of working**
* Mentor engineers, share lessons learned, and improve methods, templates, checklists, and data libraries.
* Help build a reliability engineering capability that scales with Blykalla’s project needs and supports a plant-as-a-product mindset.


**Typical deliverables**
* Reliability design basis and RAM targets; reliability block diagrams, fault trees, and availability models; RAM and production-availability study reports; FMEA / FMECA and criticality registers; RCM analyses; reliability data and failure-rate libraries; Weibull / life-data analysis; common-cause and spares / logistics inputs; condition-monitoring and testing requirements; reliability inputs to the safety analysis / PSA interface; supplier reliability review comments; interface registers; change requests; and handover closeout inputs.


**Who You Are**
 You are expected to keep yourself up to date with the latest advancements and continuously improve the skills of your trade, while having in mind the expectations below.
   

  

**Domain knowledge**
* Bring 6+ years of experience in reliability / RAM engineering, including hands-on nuclear experience (RAM and PSA-support analysis for nuclear plants or systems).
* Lead reliability engineering across a major plant area, a full project, or multiple complex work packages, with emphasis on quantitative RAM modeling and analysis.
* Solve ambiguous problems by taking a broad view of technical, delivery, data, and interface constraints, and set analysis, data, and modeling standards for the discipline.
* Technical understanding and practical application of reliability and dependability standards (IEC 60300 series, IEC 61078, 61025, 61165, 61649, 60812) and nuclear PSA practice using RiskSpectrum, with ISO 14224 / OREDA and nuclear reliability data and applicable IAEA and regulatory guidance (for example US NRC / NUREG and Swedish SSM).
* Coach engineers across teams and raise the overall capability of the discipline.


**Business understanding**
* Anticipate issues with broad impact on availability, schedule, supplier performance, commissioning readiness, or lifecycle cost and act before they become critical.
* Give significant input to function strategy, resource planning, and ways of working across Plant Engineering, balancing technical rigor with practical delivery.


**Cultural contribution**
* Act as a role model across teams and create an environment that brings out the best in others.
* Build trust across functions by being transparent, dependable, and solution-oriented.


**Main metrics**
**Main Metrics For This Role May Include**
* Reliability deliverables and analyses issued to the agreed plan.
* Deliverable quality, including first-pass review quality, model traceability, and preventable late changes.
* Closure time for review comments, supplier queries, RFIs, and interface issues.
* Quality and confidence of RAM models, FMECA, and availability predictions.
* Contributions to team capability through mentoring, standards, and tool improvement.


**Security obligations**
 The employee shall adhere to all governing policies, guidelines, and instructions of Blykalla such as information security policy, acceptable use of company assets, data privacy policies, and employee code of ethics.
   

  

****Who you’ll get to work with****
 The Reliability Engineer sits in the Plant Engineering Team within Blykalla, and reports to the Manager of Plant Engineering. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla.
   

  

**Location**
 This position is for our office in Stockholm.
   

  

**So, what do you think?**
 Don't miss the chance to be at the forefront of revolutionizing nuclear power. Join our team as Reliability Engineer and help shape the energy landscape of tomorrow. Apply today with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and achievements.
   

  

 We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply, and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about power supply!
   

  

**Reference & Background Checks**
 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates. We may also conduct reference checks to gain a well-rounded understanding of your professional experience, performance, and ways of working. This includes both references provided by you and, where relevant, conversations with other professional contacts who have worked closely with you. We strive to be transparent about our reference-checking process and handle all personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. Any additional references will be sought with professional judgment and only when considered relevant to the role.
   

  

 Salary Range: SEK 60 000 – 76 000/ month, depending on experience and qualifications.
   

  

 We offer competitive compensation aligned with our internal salary framework and growth potential in the role.
   

  

**We do not accept applications via email.**
 We are not open to external help from recruitment agencies.
   

  

**Note on AI Use:** 
 Blykalla may use AI technology to assist with certain administrative aspects of the hiring process, such as note-taking, interview documentation, and reporting. However, every resume and application is reviewed directly by our recruiting team. AI tools are used solely for operational support and do not influence candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.

title: Senior Investigator
description:

 Your role and opportunities

 Responsibilities:

title: Sr Quality Assurance Engineer - Sana
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

  

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.  



  

**About the Team**

  

Sana is an AI lab building superintelligence for work. We believe organizations can accomplish their missions faster when teams can effortlessly access knowledge, automate repetitive work, and learn anything with the help of agentic AI. As part of Workday, we are committed to building AI that augments people - not replaces them.
  

  

We bring this mission to life through two products. Sana Agents provide a seamless way to access all your company’s apps, knowledge, and data, enabling AI agents to do real work so teams can process and act on information at unprecedented scale. Sana Learn is an AI-powered learning hub that combines the simplicity of a modern learning platform with intelligent features like an AI tutor, automated content generation, and interactive apps, making knowledge not just accessible but actionable.
  

  

We’re a talent-dense, product-obsessed team of engineers and designers from companies like Google, Spotify, Apple, and Databricks, united by deep technical excellence and rapid iteration. Our tools already help over a million people learn and work better across hundreds of leading enterprises - and we’re just getting started  

  

**About the Role**

  

The Sr. Quality Assurance Engineer will develop, modify, and complete software test plans, automated scripts and programs for testing. They debug software products through the use of detailed tests to apply and maintain quality standards for Workday's products. The Sr. QA Engineer will also ensure that system tests are efficiently completed, documented and resolved.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**  

  

* Develop test plans and scripts. Ensure test scripts and activities meet business requirements

  

* Analyze test results and report any defects, bugs, errors, configuration issues, and interoperability flaws.

  

* Ensure that all issues that are subsequently resolved are then re-tested for resolution.

  

* Complete functional test cases based on test plan

  

* Comprehensive testing and tracking of issues in release(s)

  

* Identify and communicate high-risk areas to the development team
  

**About You**

  

**Basic Qualifications:**  



* 8+ years experience in software quality assurance engineering, defining test strategies, leading testing efforts, and ensuring high-quality software releases.

  

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  

**Other Qualifications:**  



* Experience working in an IT or Quality Assurance environment or business analysis work around automated or manual testing techniques and approaches

-Experience with end to end testing - Testing Planning, Test Execution, UAT, Regression.


* Experience crafting automation test suites at scale, in at least one of these tools: JUnit, Bamboo, Silk Test, Selenium, or Cypress.

For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here .  



Primary Location Base Pay Range: €69,600 SEK - €104,400 SEK Sweden

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role).
